Model-based variance of a logistic fixed-effect fit

Source: R/model_logistic_fe.R
vcov.logistic_fe.Rd

The inverse of the observed information for \(\beta\) after profiling out the provider effects. The model-based variances of the provider effects are returned as the attribute "var_gamma"; see gamma_variance() for the choice of variance used by the Wald test.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'logistic_fe'
vcov(object, ...)

Arguments

object

a model fitted by fit_logistic_fe().

...

unused.

Value

A covariance matrix for beta with attribute "var_gamma".
